findings.body: The required C6 transition is untested. This rerun reuses a fixture where July Budget is already loaded, so it only proves that an already-runnable DUB+CHIR comparison remains narrowed to DUB. There is no test that first saves the selection from a DUB-only no-budget Informational response, makes that month's budget batch active, reruns it, and verifies DUB is now executed with no `leftOut`. That dynamic re-evaluation is a named regression case and could be broken by caching coverage or persisting an effective empty/narrowed selection without any current test failing.
findings.title: Not done: saved no-budget comparisons rerun after a budget load

findings.body: The backend emits `plantNames`, `budgetStates`, and `leftOut`, but the unchanged Ask UI still does not consume them. Its informational branch at `frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx:238` renders only `definition`, so the no-budget `message` is blank; null Budget/% cells also lack the required accessible labels, and no plant or left-out readout appears. The Tasks table assigns this presentation work to MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS must render the new answer metadata

findings.body: The response now spreads row presentation beside row-keyed budget metadata, but `answerRowShape` at `backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:1073` still recognizes only single-dimension `gl_code` and `leaf_key` answers. Consequently, `gl_code × plant` and `leaf_key × plant` cannot receive per-row labels or drill contexts, and the required inert composite month shapes are not yet proven through `askRowKey`. The Tasks table assigns this work to MP-ASK-DRILL.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-DRILL must support composite row identities
